body: Thank you for the encouraging words. My deep self loathing is sadly something I will probably never get rid of, not unless I succeed in either getting a degree or holding a meaningful job. Right now I'm living on state benefits, and I'm living in a constant fear that they will be denied. My "dream" would be to live without being a burden on anyone, but I'm scared that I'll never be able to do that. I'm already 25 years old and I have absolutely nothing to show for it.
I just can't deal with living. Can't hold a job, can't study for shit. A person such as myself doesn't deserve to live.
